notes.title: Coming Soon! Battle Tea b1.4 - The Party Update
notes.content:
We've recently updated our game to the version b1.3, fixing a lot of problems from previous versions, adding some new content, and redoing some parts of the code.

However, the next update will be a big step in the good direction.

[h1]Battle Tea b1.4 - The Party Update[/h1]
This new update will bring up a lot of new content and possibilities, these include but are not limited to:
[list]
[*] Support for 8 simultaneous players!
[*] Support for playing on teams instead of FFA.
[*] QOL improvements, specially on lobby searching.
[/list]

This was done while testing 8-player functionality:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44064528/33c54ed0f147fc94e0ffe0eb09f2180c759ad893.jpg[/img]

Hopefully this new features will bring an even more complete product for release.
Cheers, AntikoreDev.
